##Rental Desert
```{r echo = T, results = 'hide'}
# Set file paths (update with actual IRIS data CSV file paths)
housing_data_path <- "/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/France_housing/Copy of base-ic-logement-2021.csv"

# Load IRIS data (assuming it includes geographic coordinates)
housing_data <- read.csv(housing_data_path, sep = ",", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)
```

```{r echo = T, results = 'hide'}
# Summarize main population and housing data by region
summary <- housing_data %>%
  group_by(IRIS) %>%  # Group by IRIS code
  summarise(total_main_residences = sum(P21_RP, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_population = sum(P21_NPER_RP, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_houses = sum(P21_RPMAISON, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_apartments = sum(P21_RPAPPART, na.rm = TRUE),
            total_vacant_dwellings = sum(P21_LOGVAC, na.rm = TRUE))

# 2. Calculate rental housing units and total housing units
france_rental <- housing_data %>%
  mutate(
    rental_hu = P21_RP_LOC, # Number of rental housing units
    tot_hsg_units = P21_RP, # Total number of housing units
    rental_sh = (rental_hu / tot_hsg_units) * 100, # Rental share in percentage
    rental_des = ifelse(rental_sh < 20, 1, 0) # Rental desert if share is under 20%
  )

# 3. Check the summary of the data
#summary(france_rental)

# 4. Calculate total housing units and the share of rental deserts
total_hsg_units <- sum(france_rental$tot_hsg_units, na.rm = TRUE)
rental_desert_share <- prop.table(table(france_rental$rental_des)) * 100

# 5. Display the results
print(paste("Total Housing Units: ", total_hsg_units))
rental_desert_share_deserts <- rental_desert_share["1"] # Extract the percentage for rental_des = 1
print(paste("Share of Rental Deserts (%):", rental_desert_share_deserts))
```

```{r}
# Calculate average rental share across IRIS regions
france_rental %>%
  summarise(avg_rental_sh = mean(rental_sh, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate total number of housing units across IRIS regions
france_rental %>%
  summarise(total_housing_units = sum(tot_hsg_units, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate the number and share of IRIS regions that are rental deserts
france_rental %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_des)) %>%
  mutate(iris_count = 1) %>%
  group_by(rental_des) %>%
  summarise(total_iris = sum(iris_count)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_iris / sum(total_iris) * 100)

write.csv(france_rental, "/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/france_rental.csv")
```

```{r}
# Calculate the distribution of all IRIS regions by municipality type
iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_des)) %>%
  mutate(IRIS_count = 1) %>%
  group_by(mncplt_) %>%
  summarise(total_iris = sum(IRIS_count)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_iris / sum(total_iris) * 100) %>%
  filter(total_iris > 0) # Ensure no NaN values due to division by zero

# Calculate the distribution of rental deserts by municipality type
iris_with_population_and_rental %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_des), rental_des == 1) %>%
  group_by(mncplt_) %>%
  summarise(total_rental_deserts = sum(rental_des)) %>%
  mutate(share = total_rental_deserts / sum(total_rental_deserts) * 100) %>%
  filter(total_rental_deserts > 0)
```


##IRIS: income + Rental Housing
```{r}
# Set file paths (update with actual IRIS data CSV file paths)"
income_data_path <- "/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/France_income/Copy of BASE_TD_FILO_IRIS_2021_DEC.csv"

# Load IRIS data (assuming it includes geographic coordinates)
income_data <- read.csv(income_data_path, sep = ",", header = TRUE, fill = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

# Ensure both datasets have the "IRIS" column for the join
france_rental_with_income <- france_rental %>%
  left_join(income_data, by = "IRIS")

# Drop the redundant columns and keep only the unique ones
france_rental_with_income <- france_rental_with_income %>%
  select(-ends_with(".y")) %>%
  # Optionally, rename columns to remove the .x suffix if needed
  rename_with(~ gsub("\\.x$", "", .))

# Check the result
#head(france_rental_with_income)

# Optionally, save the resulting dataset to a CSV or shapefile if needed
write.csv(france_rental_with_income, "/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_France_Rental_with_Income.csv")
```


```{r}
france_rental_with_income <- france_rental_with_income %>%
  mutate(rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
    rental_sh < 20 ~ "1 RentalDesert",
    rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "2 MixedTenure",
    rental_sh >= 80 ~ "3 HighRental"
  ))

# Calculate and summarize average share of single-family homes by neighborhood category
france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat)) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(avg_sfsh = mean(P21_MAISON / P21_LOG * 100, na.rm = TRUE))

# Calculate and summarize average share of multi-family housing by neighborhood category
france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat)) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(avg_mf_5pl = mean(P21_APPART / P21_LOG * 100, na.rm = TRUE))
```


##IRIS: Low-Income Rate 
```{r}
# Average median incomes by rental category
france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh) & !is.na(DEC_MED21)) %>% 
  mutate(rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
    rental_sh < 20 ~ "1 RentalDesert",
    rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "2 MixedTenure",
    rental_sh >= 80 ~ "3 HighRental"
  )) %>% 
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>% 
  summarise(avg_income = mean(DEC_MED21, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
# Generate the bar chart
ggplot(data = france_rental_with_income, aes(x = DEC_MED21)) +
  geom_bar(fill = 'skyblue', color = 'black') +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = 'Distribution of DEC_MED21',
    x = 'DEC_MED21',
    y = 'Count'
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))  # Rotate x-axis labels if necessary
```

```{r}
# Categorizing each IRIS based on median income and calculating shares
france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh) & !is.na(DEC_MED21)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20 ~ "1 RentalDesert",
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "2 MixedTenure",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "3 HighRental"
    ),
    low_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 < 12080, 1, 0),
    middle_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 >= 12080 & DEC_MED21 <= 41230, 1, 0),
    high_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 > 41230, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_lish = mean(low_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_mish = mean(middle_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_hish = mean(high_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  )
```

```{r}
# Data preparation
income_shares <- france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh) & !is.na(DEC_MED21)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20 ~ "Rental Deserts",
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "Mixed-Tenure Neighborhoods",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental Neighborhoods"
    ),
    low_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 < 12080, 1, 0),
    middle_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 >= 12080 & DEC_MED21 <= 41230, 1, 0),
    high_income_flag = if_else(DEC_MED21 > 41230, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(rd_nbrhd_cat) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_lish = mean(low_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_mish = mean(middle_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    avg_hish = mean(high_income_flag, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("avg_"), names_to = "Income Level", values_to = "Share") %>%
  mutate(`Income Level` = recode(`Income Level`,
                                "avg_lish" = "Low Income",
                                "avg_mish" = "Middle Income",
                                "avg_hish" = "High Income"))

# Plotting
ggplot(income_shares, aes(x = `Income Level`, y = Share, fill = rd_nbrhd_cat)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Average Share by Income Level and Neighborhood Type",
       x = "Household Income",
       y = "Average Share (Percent)",
       fill = "Neighborhood Type") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#e5c3c6", "#b089bc", "#4d004b")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)

# Load the shapefile (assuming it's in a file named 'iris_shapefile.shp')
iris_with_population <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Population.shp")
# Select necessary columns and perform the join
selected_rental_data <- france_rental_with_income %>%
  filter(!is.na(rental_sh)) %>%
  mutate(
    rd_nbrhd_cat = case_when(
      rental_sh < 20 ~ "Rental Desert",
      rental_sh >= 20 & rental_sh < 80 ~ "Mixed-Tenure",
      rental_sh >= 80 ~ "High-Rental"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(IRIS, rd_nbrhd_cat)

# Merge with spatial data
map_data <- iris_with_population %>%
  left_join(selected_rental_data, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS"))

# Ensure no NAs in key columns for plotting
map_data <- map_data %>% filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat))

# Plotting the map
ggplot(data = map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = rd_nbrhd_cat)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rental Desert" = "#a6bddb", "Mixed-Tenure" = "#3690c0", "High-Rental" = "#034e7b")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "IRIS Rental Categories in France", fill = "Rental Category")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)

# Load your polygon shapefile
# Ensure this file is actually a polygon geom type
iris_shapefile_poly <- st_read("C:/Users/ohdaw/OneDrive/Documents/R_Projects/rental_desert/France/Updated_IRIS_with_Population.shp")

# Convert CRS to WGS 84
iris_shapefile_poly <- st_transform(iris_shapefile_poly, crs = 4326)

# Merge with income data
map_data_poly <- iris_shapefile_poly %>%
  left_join(selected_rental_data, by = c("CODE_IR" = "IRIS")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rd_nbrhd_cat))

# Define palette
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("Rental Desert" = "#a6bddb", "Mixed-Tenure" = "#3690c0", "High-Rental" = "#034e7b"),
  domain = map_data_poly$rd_nbrhd_cat
)

# Create the interactive map
leaflet(map_data_poly) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    radius = 2,
    color = ~ifelse(rd_nbrhd_cat == "Rental Desert", "red", 
                    ifelse(rd_nbrhd_cat == "Mixed-Tenure", "blue", "green")),
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    label = ~paste("Category:", rd_nbrhd_cat)
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    colors = c("red", "blue", "green"),
    labels = c("Rental Desert", "Mixed-Tenure", "High-Rental"),
    title = "Neighborhood Type"
  )
```
